_comment: Default rules for rating computers in Reports (Good / Check / Needs attention). Edited in CIPP under Reports > Device Rules; saved changes are stored in the ReportSettings table and override these defaults. kind 'below': Needs attention when the value is below 'attention', Check when it is at or below 'check'. kind 'above': Check when the value is above 'check', Needs attention when it is above 'attention'. kind 'flag': 'severity' is attention, check or off. kind 'setting': a plain value. A blank (null) threshold is never triggered.

rules.label: Intel Core processor generation
rules.help: 8 = 8th gen (i5-8500). Intel Core Ultra and Core 3/5/7 count as 14th gen or later.

rules.label: Memory fitted
rules.help: Rounded to the nearest GB (8 GB fitted often shows as 7.8 GB).

rules.label: Processor cannot run Windows 11
rules.help: From Microsoft's supported processor lists. Not applied to servers.
